name: split stretch spine rolling
description: A seated straddle position with a rolling spine movement. It loosens your back and inner thighs.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide in a comfortable split.
Sit tall and reach your arms forward.
Round your spine and roll down slowly, one segment at a time.
Roll back up slowly until you are upright.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps without forcing the stretch.
